title: T10 — Evidence
body:
# Evidence — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Claim

T10 delivered the SAFe cadence and the MSP tranche machinery: computed WSJF and WIP-bounded materialisation behind an approved PI plan, an idempotent PI tick, backlog refinement flags, a typed demo evidence gate, retro lessons, a tranche review and a benefit transition with a measured-baseline gate. The named tests exist at HEAD; this retrospective did not re-run them. Eight findings remain open; the tranche-review evidence clause (v1-p83-1, v1-p83-4) is not proved in substance.

## Evidence

- **Project record:** the 2026-11-22 snapshot `/tmp/u7-snapshot/data/programme.json` row `01a1d039-0d36-70c1-a5e8-f50956c5e3f9` — key T10, `closed`, version 11, updated 2026-11-21T01:07:58Z, tranche 4, `measured_status: built`, `viability: rework`, issues [82, 502], expected outputs `project-brief` and `evidence`, closure output `closure-review`.
- **Schema:** `migrations/0056_cadence_tranche.sql`; `migrations/0044_plan_spine.sql` for `programme_tranche` and `programme_baseline`.
- **Tests:** `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs` — `wsjf_is_computed_not_stored` (179), `materialisation_respects_wip_slots` (215), `a_zero_job_size_is_refused` (249), `an_illegal_cadence_jump_is_refused` (302), `the_cadence_states_move_only_along_the_table` (386). `crates/store/tests/refinement.rs` — `refinement_flags_unscored_and_aged_rows` (114), `a_row_that_scores_again_loses_its_flag` (152). `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs::a_credit_needs_typed_evidence` (94). `crates/actions/tests/demo_credit.rs` — `a_credit_needs_a_demo_cadence` (154), `a_credit_needs_an_accepted_deliverable` (168). `crates/store/tests/retro.rs` — `every_finding_becomes_a_lesson` (156), `retro_cannot_close_without_lessons` (190). `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused` (208). `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs` — `a_measured_baseline_enables_realization` (161), `a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization` (194). `crates/actions/tests/pi_plan_approval.rs` — `a_pending_plan_materialises_nothing` (249), `a_rejected_plan_materialises_nothing` (274), `an_approved_plan_materialises_exactly_once` (297), `an_approved_plan_still_respects_the_wip_limit` (338), `a_service_decision_cannot_approve_a_plan` (363). `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent` (153).
- **Action and job surface:** `cadence::tick` in `apps/server/src/cadence.rs`; `review_tranche_tx`, the benefit and refinement transaction functions in `crates/store/src/spine.rs`; `programmes.update` in `crates/actions/src/portfolio/programmes.rs`.
- **Governance:** tranche 4 (`01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`) is `planned`, with `authorisation_review_id` null, `authorised_at` null and `baseline_ref` null; its exit criteria name T10 among the tranche's projects. T10 is closed while the tranche is unauthorised; the rework records that fact under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`.

## Verification

An independent reader can open the named test functions and run them against real Postgres 18 in the repository's harness. This retrospective confirmed the functions exist at HEAD and did not execute them; it asserts no test result. The compile/test verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted `preflight.yml`; the local gate is `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1` (`docs/plans/03-DELIVERY.md`). The acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T10.toml`.

## Links

- Issues: https://github.com/nonagenticai/conveyor/issues/82 and https://github.com/nonagenticai/conveyor/issues/502
- Specification: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` sections 8.2, 8.3 and section 12 (T10)
- Schema: `migrations/0056_cadence_tranche.sql`, `migrations/0044_plan_spine.sql`
- Tests: `programme_cadence.rs`, `refinement.rs`, `demo_gate.rs`, `demo_credit.rs`, `retro.rs`, `tranche_review.rs`, `benefit_transition.rs`, `pi_plan_approval.rs`, `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs`
- Tranche 4: `01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`
- Standing delegation: `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`

## Gap

- **v1-p83-1 (P1).** Tranche authorisation is seeded, not earned; review evidence accepts free-text placeholders for baselines, benefit status and risk.
- **v1-p83-2 (P1).** Benefit measurement is presence-only; a realized claim has no typed baseline/post value.
- **v1-p83-3 (P1).** BCM and benefit ownership are free text, not job keys; the seeded benefits have no job owner.
- **v1-p83-4 (P1).** `programme_tranche.baseline_ref` is nullable and only existence-checked; approval and kind are not gated.
- **v1-p83-5 (P1).** `programmes.update` closes a programme without a closure review or an approved realisation plan.
- **v1-p83-6 (P2).** PMP closure reads only the scope baseline; schedule, cost and the registers are not gated.
- **v1-p82-5 (P2).** The PI backlog query pins one `project_id`; a multi-project programme plans only one project's deliverables.
- **v1-p82-6 (P2).** A lesson needs no evidence (`evidence` defaults to an empty array) and a systemic retro finding emits no kata candidate.
- No contemporaneous charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract or Phase-G review existed at the snapshot; this set is retrospective and does not attest contemporaneous intent.
